name: davdunc-plugins
description: Personal Claude plugins collection: equities trading (watchlists, trading plans, market data, DAS Trader Pro hotkeys) and life-systems analysis (Thinking in Systems applied to a personal Life OS).

plugins.name: market-data
plugins.description: Download historical US stock market data (minute and daily OHLCV with extended hours) from Massive.com flat files. Stores data locally for analysis.

plugins.name: dastrader
plugins.description: DAS Trader Pro hotkey, button, and routing assistant for Cobra Trading users. Writes and debugs DAS hotkey scripts, TriggerOrder brackets, CMD API commands, and risk-sizing entries.

plugins.name: trading
plugins.description: Intraday momentum trading intelligence: morning game plans, daily reviews (R-units, both-account aware), evening video review, SEC filings, statistical covariance, and DAS Trader integration. Includes deterministic publish workflow to Notion + Slack + DAS Market Viewer.

plugins.name: equities-watchlist
plugins.description: Daily equities watchlist and trading-plan MCP server. Screens for high-volume, high-volatility candidates using Finviz + Polygon/Massive data (RVOL, ATR, premarket volume) and builds structured morning briefs with Camarilla pivots and news.

plugins.name: lifesystems
plugins.description: Apply Donella Meadows' Thinking in Systems to a personal Life OS: stocks/flows life mapping, eight system-trap scans, 12-leverage-point goal audits, feedback-loop repair, and Dancing-with-Systems periodic reviews.
